method: Linear detrending, first supported autocorrelation maximum, published lag-zero-normalized threshold 0.5; require BOTH IR and red with Pearson >=0.90 and RMS >=10 counts
difference_from_2.0.13: Replace peak-counter-dependent period validation with a fresh independently derived optical period; previous custom normalized-pair thresholds 0.85/0.75 are replaced by the published method, not silently treated as equivalent
retained_guards: Real ADC samples, contact/clipping bounds, SpO2 reference validity and 70-100 range, signal/perfusion guards, consecutive stable oxygen windows; reject flat, drifting, inverted, mismatched or aperiodic input
acceptance_unchanged: Actual real valid BPM/SpO2 continuously >=60 s, display >=1 Hz, nominal IAQ 3 s and no FIFO loss; no stale hold, clamping or fake measurements
